classification: engineering diagnostic on already examined historical 2025 data; not fresh confirmation
training: Fixed alpha 10. Train before September 2023 on clean and three deterministic corrupted input views; each view contributes equal total weight. Feature scaling uses training rows only. No filled labels or test-year hyperparameter selection.
fairness: For each station, horizon and seed, intersect available forecast origins across all four input scenarios and require the original uncorrupted exact-time target. Every scenario and comparator is scored on that same intersection. Report scenario-specific forecast availability separately.
target: WVHT squared times APD in m^2 s; not generated electricity
record_unit: one station/horizon/seed/scenario diagnostic; seeds reuse the same historical outcomes and are not independent field observations
reporting: Retain all scores, common-pair coverage, source/code hashes and fallback counts. Report whether missingness robustness improves at the cost of clean accuracy. No statistical or commercial superiority claim is permitted from this diagnostic.
archive_policy: Preserve the prior raw/result artifact ZIP bytes with SHA-256 verification, source/run lineage and an explicit correction index in a research-only prerelease; never move main, overwrite an existing published asset, deploy, or change DNS.
next_gate: Independent review of this diagnostic, uncertainty calibration, then freeze an actually fresh evaluation period before scoring a revised method.
